articles.title: James Gray on Francis Ford Coppola’s Advice That Shaped His Career: ‘Be Personal. There’s Only One of You in This World’
articles.summary: When filmmaker James Gray was a teenager, he wrote a fan letter to Francis Ford Coppola. To his surprise, the legendary filmmaker wrote back with a piece of advice that would come to shape Gray’s entire approach to cinema. “He said, ‘Be personal, James.
body: Decades later, that philosophy remains central to Gray’s filmmaking, even as he argues that the film industry increasingly pressures directors to suppress their individual voices.

“So much of the system, the systems in the cinema, both in the United States and abroad, try to discourage you from your own voice,” he said. “Or, if they don’t discourage you actively, they try to get you to bury your voice in a larger statement, or another form of genre, where it’s hidden.”

The director was in Doha to present the MENA premiere of “ Paper Tiger,” his latest crime drama starring Adam Driver, Miles Teller and Scarlett Johansson. Set in 1980s New York, the film follows two brothers whose pursuit of the American Dream draws them into a dangerous scheme involving the Russian mafia.

Drawing heavily on his own family history, Gray described the film as an attempt to faithfully capture his father’s relationship with his uncle, while acknowledging the possible limitations of his own memory years later. He also recalled how a confrontation between his parents found its way into the film, with the actors recreating the incident almost exactly as it had unfolded in real life.
points: When filmmaker James Gray was a teenager, he wrote a fan letter to Francis Ford Coppola.
To his surprise, the legendary filmmaker wrote back with a piece of advice that would come to shape Gray’s entire approach to cinema.
Decades later, that philosophy remains central to Gray’s filmmaking, even as he argues that the film industry increasingly pressures directors to suppress their individual voices.
“So much of the system, the systems in the cinema, both in the United States and abroad, try to discourage you from your own voice,” he said.

articles.title: SXSW Forges Partnership With Egypt’s UTH Festival Dedicated to Youth Culture
articles.summary: Austin’s South by Southwest Film and TV Festival has forged a partnership with Egypt’s UTH Festival dedicated to youth culture under which UTH will become SXSW’s partner in Egypt.
body: The third edition of the just concluded UTH Festival just ran Nov. 20 and 21 at the Grand Egyptian Museum in Giza, on the west bank of the Nile opposite Cairo, attracting roughly 10,000 attendees, according to organizers. This year’s festival, held under the theme “Work in Progress,” covered fashion, design, creator economy, film, music, food and sports, among other spheres.
The announcement stems from an initiative bringing SXSW and Egyptian industry figures together during the UTH fest, which was attended by Peter Lewis, who is SXSW’s chief commercial officer.

As part of the collaboration, an Egyptian delegation comprising roughly 20 participants will travel to SXSW to attend the fest between March 13–21. Curated and led by UTH, the delegation will “bring together representatives from Egypt’s film and music industries, the creator economy, entrepreneurship, investment and institutional sectors,” according to the statement. The agreement also includes plans for “a UTH-led programming session and a community gathering in Austin,” the statement added.

articles.title: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in California ceremony
articles.summary: The couple have been together for four years and were engaged in 2025.
body: Miley Cyrus has married her partner of four years Maxx Morando during a ceremony in Palm Springs, California.
Photos of the wedding on Saturday show the ceremony took place by a swimming pool with the pair standing under an arch covered in white flowers.
The singer's mother, Tish Cyrus, and sister, Noah Cyrus, were in attendance, Entertainment Tonight reported.
Grammy-winning Cyrus, who donned a white dress for the wedding, confirmed her engagement to the 28-year-old drummer during an interview with US TV show Good Morning America last year.

body: Al-Madhhan launched a secret operation to smuggle more than 50,000 photographs out of Syria showing evidence of torture, starvation and murder in the country’s lockups. articles.title: Katseye Brings Out Camila Cabello for ‘Gabriela’ Dance at Los Angeles Show
articles.summary: Roughly six songs into their performance on Saturday night, Katseye made a girl group connection with Fifth Harmony member Camila Cabello as Daniela Avanzini brought her out to be the collective’s “Gabriela” for the evening, dancing to the choreography that accompanies the song.
body: “OK, you look stunning,” said Avanzini as Cabello joined her. “Thank you Camila, I have one question for you: Do you know the ‘Gabriela’ dance?”

“I know a little bit, just a little bit,” responded Cabello. “We’re two Latina mamis, I feel like there’s a lot of Latina mamis in here. So even if we get steps wrong, it’s the sazon that counts.” They continued on to do the “Gabriela” dance, hitting the hand-ography before Cabello left the stage and the rest of Katseye joined back up to do a full performance of the single.

Throughout the show, Katseye gave a tour of their discography from the past few years, including hits like “Pinky Up,” “Gnarly” and “Mean Girls.” Katseye, who was recently announced as the recipient of the Group of the Year Award at Variety Hitmakers’ 2026, is currently on its “Wildworld” tour amid a year that saw several members take temporary hiatuses to improve their mental health. Katseye will perform again at Crypto.com Arena on Sunday night before a show in Phoenix and a tour closer at Fort Worth, Texas’ Ariat Arena on December 1.

articles.title: Calls for Marilyn Manson performance to be pulled
articles.summary: Marilyn Manson is due to support Slipknot at Wembley Stadium in July, ahead of a trial he faces.
body: A Brent councillor has joined calls to prevent Marilyn Manson performing at Wembley Stadium next year ahead of a trial the singer faces over sexual assault allegations.
Liberal Democrat Anton Georgiou has gathered more than 20,000 signatures on a petition urging the venue to take "a firm stand" against Manson, who is due to support Slipknot there in July.
Manson, whose real name is Brian Warner, is due to stand trial next November in a civil lawsuit brought by his former assistant Ashley Walters, who alleges sexual abuse. He denies the allegation.
Georgiou has written to the promoter Live Nation and Wembley Stadium urging the organisers to cancel the performance until a verdict is reached.
points: Marilyn Manson is due to support Slipknot at Wembley Stadium in July, ahead of a trial he faces.

articles.title: Man who studied drama in young offenders' institution now a West End actor
articles.summary: Joseph Langdon, who stars in the Bristol Old Vic's production of Cinderella, learned to act while detained.
body: A former young offender who became a West End actor says taking drama lessons while he was detained was the best decision he ever made.

Joseph Langdon, who grew up in south London, was convicted of gang-related crimes at the the age of 16. But while in a young offenders' institution, he was offered drama lessons through a scheme with the Bristol Old Vic.
Langdon said the lessons taught him "that I could make something of my life, and introduced me to this world I did not think was possible".
The actor, who will play the prince in the theatre's Christmas production of Cinderella: A Fairytale, said: "I count my blessings every day. I turn up to rehearsals with a huge smile on my face."

articles.title: Du Maurier family photos shared for first time
articles.summary: Photos showing the author and her family have been shared for the first time by her grandson.
body: A set of photos of globally renowned 20th century author Daphne du Maurier has been shared by her family for the first time.
The photos show du Maurier in a series of family images, in settings including around Cornwall where she lived and did most of her writing - she died in 1989.
Her eldest grandson Paul de Zulueta found the pictures while researching a new book telling the personal story of his grandmother's artistic dynasty.
He said: "They were all tucked away in my mother's box. She said you might find this amusing - there's a box of photos here."

articles.title: 31 Years Later, Buzz Lightyear's Best Line Is Still The Greatest Pixar Quote Ever
articles.summary: Toy Story is full of lovable characters and memorable moments, including the Buzz Lightyear quote that sums up the Pixar animated classic as a whole.
body: It doesn't matter how many movies Pixar makes, the studio's biggest achievement will forever be the "Toy Story" franchise. To be sure, there's a reason several "Toy Story" films rank among Pixar's highest rated movies on Rotten Tomatoes, as the animated property has endured for decades and continues to resonate with audiences. Even now, the very first "Toy Story" flick remains the standard for Pixar films (and not just because it launched a reliable hit-maker at the box office ).

In addition to establishing Pixar as an animation studio worth paying attention to, 1995's "Toy Story" marked the arrival of 3D computer animation. It's essentially to animation what "Jurassic Park" was to visual effects, signaling a change from what had come before cinematically. At the same time, "Toy Story" is fairly small in its scale, which is a testament to just how well its story and characters work. It's not about grand adventures with huge set pieces, it's a simple tale about a cowboy toy learning to accept change in his life and a space ranger toy realizing he's not who he believed he was (and that's okay).

articles.title: 20 Years Ago Today: Hugh Jackman Starred In A Sci-Fi Movie That Divided Critics
articles.summary: One of Hugh Jackman's best performances is in this underseen 2006 sci-fi movie that divided critics and bombed at the box office.
body: "The Fountain" was greenlit on a $60 million budget with Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett cast as lovers facing, in the present day, the certain death of the latter via cancer. Pitt's character is a cancer researcher who's unwilling to accept Blanchett's death; he's close to a breakthrough, but the die is cast. When the budget threatened to balloon, Warner Bros. got nervous. Then Pitt dropped out, Blanchett followed and the project was pretty much dead.

But Aronofsky, much like the protagonist of his screenplay, couldn't let go. He scaled back the screenplay, figured out a way to deliver the eye-popping visual effects at a reasonable cost, and somehow got Hugh Jackman and Rachel Weisz to sign on at a reasonable price. "The Fountain" was greenlit yet again, at which point Warner Bros. was again faced with the challenge of how to sell this cerebral sci-fi epic. Aronofsky made the best film of his career thus far ( and Jackman has rarely been better ), but the studio couldn't figure out the marketing. Ergo, it bombed.
points: One of Hugh Jackman's best performances is in this underseen 2006 sci-fi movie that divided critics and bombed at the box office.

articles.title: The Next ‘The Witcher’ Book Is Officially Delayed
articles.summary: Geralt of Rivia owes Yennefer of Vengerberg a better introduction than the one he gives her in The Last Wish. The Witcher needs a sorceress because his friend Dandelion has gotten into trouble with a djinn, and Yennefer has plans for the creature that go beyond patching up a bard.
body: Hannah covers horror, sci-fi, and games at Collider, where she writes news and features, reviews new releases, and interviews the people who make them. She’s helping build out Collider ’s gaming coverage, with Pokémon as one of her specialties. If she isn’t writing about a monster, she’s probably watching one on a tape from her VHS collection.

When Hachette announced the English release of Crossroads of Ravens, the prequel about Geralt’s early days as a witcher, the deal came with something for fans who already owned the rest of the series. David French, who translated the prequel and six of the eight books that preceded it, would go back to the two Stok had translated. Hachette originally put both on its 2026 calendar. By August, their U.S. release date had moved to April 27, 2027.

Orbit now lists July 27, 2027, as the U.S. release date for French’s new English translations of The Last Wish and Blood of Elves, putting both books another three months behind the April date. The publisher has updated the paperback and ebook listings for both titles. Crossroads of Ravens, Sapkowski’s most recent original Geralt adventure, is already available in English.
